messages.content: What is 17 times 23? Think carefully then answer.

message.content:
To calculate $17 \times 23$, we can break it down using the distributive property or standard multiplication.

**Method 1: Distributive Property**
Break 23 into $20 + 3$:
$$17 \times 23 = 17 \times (20 + 3)$$
$$= (17 \times 20) + (17 \times 3)$$

Calculate each part:
1.  $17 \times 20 = 340$
2.  $17 \times 3 = 51$

Add them together:
$$340 + 51 = 391$$

**Method 2: Standard Vertical Multiplication**
$$
\begin{array}{r}
  17 \\
\times 23 \\
\hline
  51 & (3 \times 17) \\
+340 & (20 \times 17) \\
\hline
  391
\end{array}
$$

**Answer:**
17 times 23 is **391**.
